profile_text: As a leading logistics and supply chain management company in North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany, this subsidiary of Amazon specializes in streamlining the flow of goods and products, driving an 83.9% growth in employees since its baseline. With a focus on efficient transportation and storage solutions, the company has established itself as a key player in the region, supporting the e-commerce giant's expanding operations. By 2024, the company has scaled to 366 employees, earning its classification as a Gazelle, a rapidly growing business.
